content:
Two independent bookstores, Leave a Bookshop (留下書舍) and Garden Books (田園書屋), were raided by national security police the day before yesterday (the 15th), with arrests made. It is understood that three people from Leave a Bookshop and two people from Garden Books were arrested on suspicion of committing the offence of sedition under Article 23.

A government press release stated that the National Security Department of the police, following a referral from the Customs and Excise Department, conducted an investigation and arrested five people at the two bookstores in Mong Kok on suspicion of violating Section 24 of the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance — the offence of "acting with seditious intent" with seditious intent — and confiscated a batch of books.
